_comment: Installable-service catalog for the Service Manager card. `name` = registered service name (matches deploy/seed/<name>/service.json); `dir` = checkout directory under the stack root; `repo` = public clone URL; `branch` (optional) = clone this branch instead of the repo default. `needs_kit` = frontend build aliases lilak_ui via LILAK_UI_PATH. Install jobs skip missing frontend/requirements gracefully, so entries stay small.
